Lane Kiffin's Return to Ole Miss Draws Player Comments

Ole Miss players have publicly commented on the return of former coach Lane Kiffin, who is now coaching LSU. The players indicated they are not making much of Kiffin's return. Kiffin previously coached Ole Miss before moving to LSU.
